name: Default
shortDescription: Interactive HTTPS proxy with the mitmweb interface, running as a reverse proxy so you can inspect, modify and replay requests sent to an upstream server.

alerts.message: Set MITM_UPSTREAM to the server you want to inspect (it defaults to https://example.com), then send traffic to the proxy.<domain> address. Log in to the web interface with WEB_PASSWORD from the environment.
Only reverse proxy mode works here: regular, transparent and WireGuard modes need a raw port that is not routed over HTTPS.
